<thought>To build a valid retrosynthetic route, I will first locate a template that can disconnect the ether linkage in the target molecule. This will give two fragments: the cyclohexane core (similar to shikimic acid) and the side‑chain containing the conjugated diene and carboxylic acid. I will then verify that the fragments correspond to commercially available compounds.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ether"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
